item.title: Nintendo says it’s not planning another Switch 2 price hike
item.description: Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said during the company's latest earnings call that it's "not considering additional changes" to the Switch 2's price, Reuters reports. The Switch 2 got a $50 price hike earlier this year, bringing its starting price up to $499. Nintendo said in Thursday's earnings report that Switch 2 sales have dropped 37.4 percent year-over-year. According to Reuters , Furukawa also gave an update on the RAM shortage, saying, "There has been no major change to the memory situation and Nintendo is in a position to secure sufficient quantities." item.title: Should Red Sox Target Freddy Peralta In Free Agency?
item.description: Free agent pitcher Freddy Peralta The Boston Red Sox have a very good lineup and rotation when healthy, but injuries held them back last season. Even if they are healthy going into next season, they have some moves they need to make in the offseason. Sonny Gray was a huge part of the team last season, but he is a free agent now. The Red Sox could look to replace him on the open market. Obviously, Tarik Skubal is the top pitcher available, and the Red Sox are not really expected to go after him. However, they could consider going after Freddy Peralta, who is at worst the third best pitcher on the open market. Peralta was acquired by the New York Mets before the regular season, but traded to the Tampa Bay Rays at the deadline. Peralta was not good on the Mets, and the two-time All-Star looked like he was going to have to sign a prove it deal as a free agent. However, the Rays got him back to looking like an All-Star. Looking for the perfect gift for a baseball player in your life? Check out our brand new baseball lifestyle brand! The Rays had him throw his changeup more, pitch out the stretch and move his position on the rubber. All of that resulted in a 3.25 ERA for the Rays in 10 regular season starts. He had a 0.79 ERA in his final six regular season starts. Peralta was exceptional in the postseason and won the American League Championship Series MVP Award. He could join the Red Sox and round out a great starting rotation. Garrett Crochet, Payton Tolle, Ranger Suarez, Peralta and Jake Bennett would be a great group. item.title: 3 Candidates that the New York Liberty Need to Consider After Chris Demarco Firing
item.description: New York Liberty head coach Chris DeMarco calls a play against the Atlanta Dream in the third quarter during game one of the second round for the 2026 WNBA Playoffs at State Farm Arena. Mandatory Credit: Brett Davis, Imagn Images via Reuters … | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Daniel Benjamin, Editor After just one season as head coach of the New York Liberty, Chris Demarco was let go on Tuesday morning. The Liberty finished the season 26-18. During the first round of the 2026 WNBA playoffs, the Liberty swept the No. 1 seed Minnesota Lynx. In the second round, they were swept by the Atlanta Dream. This news of letting Demarco go poses the question: who will the next coach be? Let’s take a look at what didn’t quite go right and potential next-coach candidates. Why the Liberty Fired Chris Demarco After 1 Season Different Lineup Changes Atlanta Dream guard Rhyne Howard (10) and New York Liberty forward Breanna Stewart (30) reacts after the Atlanta Dream defeated the New York Liberty in game three of the second round for the 2026 WNBA Playoffs at Barclays Center. Photo Credit: Wendell Cruz, Imagn Images via Reuters Connect While the Liberty team kept its core intact with Breanna Stewart , Jonquel Jones , Sabrina Ionescu , and Leonie Fiebich, things were looking promising early on. An offseason acquisition of Satou Sabally also made waves around the league due to her leadership and experience. However, injuries kept knocking Sabally down, ultimately keeping her out for most of the season. Additionally, Ionescu (13 games) and Fiebich (23) sat out at least 10 contests. As a result, DeMarco would often put different lineups on the floor during games — the Liberty used 18 different players and 15 starting lineups. The problem was that the lineups often did not make sense, especially given the team’s depth and the chemistry among players who had been teammates in different leagues. The constant rotation of lineups has been proven unsuccessful. Changing the lineups often disrupts the on-court chemistry. It can also mess with any game plans that had been written up. A Lack of Concern Demarco entered the season with no experience coaching a women’s basketball team before this stint with the Liberty. He was an assistant coach for the Golden State Warriors, and coached the Bahamas men’s national basketball team. Acquiring someone with NBA coaching experience with a successful franchise looked promising. However, Demarco was unable to execute a plan to lead the Liberty through the entire playoffs. There were many games this season in which Demarco was not part of the team huddle during timeouts. Stewart would take the team on her back and speak to them in these moments. A coach needs to be a leader for their team. Leadership is one of the qualities that was missing during this season. item.title: Saudi Arabia executes five Ethiopians for hashish smuggling
item.description: Saudi Arabia has executed five Ethiopian nationals convicted of drug smuggling, bringing the kingdom’s execution toll this year to 205, according to the country’s Interior Ministry. The five were convicted of participating in smuggling hashish into the kingdom, the ministry said in a statement published by the official Saudi Press Agency on Thursday. They were executed in Asir, a province in southwestern Saudi Arabia. The latest executions are the third such announcement involving Ethiopian nationals in recent months. Five Ethiopians were executed on the same day in June, while another five were put to death in July. With the latest executions, 32 Ethiopian nationals have been executed in Saudi Arabia this year, making them the largest foreign national group among those executed. Human Rights Watch warned in July that at least 79 Ethiopians faced an imminent risk of execution over similar drug-related charges. Saudi Arabia recorded 356 executions last year, the highest annual figure in the kingdom’s history. Thousands of Ethiopians work in low-skilled jobs in Saudi Arabia, with many travelling to the oil-rich kingdom through the perilous Eastern Route from the Horn of Africa via Yemen. item.title: Spain coach De la Fuente among mourners at tragic footballer De Miguel's funeral
item.description: Tenerife footballer Jesus de Miguel's funeral was attended by around 400 mourners (Cesar MANSO) Spain's World Cup-winning coach Luis de la Fuente and the president of Real Madrid were among several hundred mourners who paid their respects at Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel's funeral on Thursday. De Miguel, 30, died following a sickening collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during a second division match on Monday. Around 400 mourners, most dressed in traditional black, gathered outside the church in the village of Navahermosa, around 100 kilometres (62 miles) southwest of Madrid, to greet the funeral cortege. They included De la Fuente and Real Madrid chief Florentino Perez. Flags flew at half mast in Navahermosa, the birthplace of De Miguel's parents and where his grandparents still reside, after the council declared three days of mourning. "We do not have enough words to thank all those who have sent messages, called or attested how much affection they had for him," said De Miguel's agent, reading out a statement on behalf of the family, who stood with him outside the funeral home before setting off for the church. They added they would like their privacy to be respected and expressed "their need to be allowed to grieve in peace as is normal in such a situation." Once the cortege arrived at the church, De Miguel's Tenerife teammates acted as pall bearers and carried his coffin into the church. - 'Immense pain' - Earlier on Thursday Spain's footballers' union asked that all this weekend's matches be postponed as a mark of respect. The men and women players "in every category", who were polled by the AFE union, believe "unanimously" that this weekend's matches "should not be played", it said. Tenerife's second division match at Granada and Andorra's clash with Mallorca have already been postponed, as were several midweek cup fixtures. "The footballers have expressed their deep sorrow for this loss and do not believe that there are the psychological and humane conditions necessary for the competition to be played in normal circumstances," AFE added. Tenerife are to pay homage to De Miguel -- who last season played a pivotal role in the club being promoted to the second tier -- on Saturday afternoon at the club's stadium. Spanish police sources have told AFP an investigation into what happened has been opened, under judicial supervision. Owono, for his part, has been subjected to a torrent of online abuse, a lot of it racist. The 25-year-old Equatorial Guinea international spoke on Wednesday of his "immense pain over the loss of Jesus". "These are the hardest days of my life," he said in a statement issued by his club. "I struggle to find the words and it is very difficult for me to process anything that has happened. "I feel immense pain over the loss of Jesus. I think of him, of his family, and of all the people who loved him. "I know there will be many issues to address, and I will face whatever comes with the utmost respect. But right

item.title: Ja Morant ditches signature locs and debuts new look after drastic haircut
item.description: Ja Morant ditches signature locs and debuts new look after drastic haircut originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Out with the old, in with the new. Ja Morant is serving up a new look amid his injury recovery, where he is ditching his signature locs. In a video shared on Nov. 4, the Portland Trail Blazers star shocked the internet when he revealed that he will now be rocking a low cut instead of the locs fans have associated with his look. Big chop!!👀✂️ https://t.co/mfP85UJZVz — Catch12 (@Catch12media) November 5, 2026 Morant also shared a sequence of photos on his Instagram Wednesday that showed the hair stylist cutting off the locs. After a couple of slides showed his hair on the floor as he sat in the chair, a photo revealed Morant's reaction: a big smile as he gazed at half of his hair waiting to be cut, and then the other side showing his newly cut hair. Towards the end of the post, the last three photos showed Morant rocking the new cut underneath a green hat as he made his way onto a private plane. He most likely was boarding the plane to go to Arizona, where they faced the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday. Fans responded to the new cut in the comments, with one fan asking, "Freshman year cut ain’t it?" " he’s backkkkkkkkk," another fan wrote, adding the celebration emoji. The Trail Blazers defeated the Suns 132-119. While the Trail Blazers were able to pull off the win, Morant was sidelined due to a Grade 2 left hamstring strain he suffered last month. On Oct. 30, it was announced that he would miss at least four weeks. So far this season, he's averaging 15.8 points, 2.5 rebounds, and 5.5 assists across the four games he has played. Morant reacted to how the injury and the mental toll it put on him. "You want to be out there knowing you can't. That's, I feel like, the even tougher part," Morant stated . "I feel like nobody in this league would get injured and, you know, be able to play and not play, pretty much, unless it's like something where we like, 'All right, if I go play, I maybe can hurt it worse or anything.'" "So mentally, it can have you down on yourself. Actually, it can make you, you know, question everything, like, 'Why it had to be me? Why at this time?'" While Morant is not on the court for now, the Trail Blazers will be back on the road again to face the Los Angeles Lakers on Nov. 6 at 10 p.m. ET. item.title: Virat Kohli’s record in Wellington: How the Indian talisman has performed at Hnry Stadium in all formats
item.description: Virat Kohli’s record in Wellington: How the Indian talisman has performed at Hnry Stadium in all formats originally appeared on Cricket News . Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . KEY TAKEAWAYS: Virat Kohli returns to Wellington for India's second ODI against New Zealand on November 7. India talisman has batted once in an ODI at Hnry Stadium, making 82 in a defeat in 2014. The ground has never hosted a Test, with Wellington's red-ball cricket played at the Basin Reserve. Has Virat Kohli played at Hnry Stadium? Wellington has two international grounds, and Virat Kohli has played at both. Hnry Stadium, the ground formerly known as Westpac and then Sky Stadium, hosts the white-ball cricket, while Tests in the city are staged at the Basin Reserve, a short distance away. At Hnry Stadium, Kohli has batted once in an ODI and once in a T20I, in January 2014 and January 2020, respectively. He was rested for India's other fixtures at the venue, including the final two ODIs of the 2019 tour and the T20I series that preceded them. India play their second ODI of this series here on Saturday, November 7, with Kohli fresh from 74 at Eden Park that took him past Sachin Tendulkar for the most ODI runs in a chase. MORE: Has India ever won a Test series in New Zealand? Virat Kohli's record in Wellington A format-by-format breakdown across the city's two grounds. Format and venue Matches Innings Runs Highest score Average Hundreds ODI (Hnry Stadium) 1 1 82 82 82.00 0 T20I (Hnry Stadium) 1 1 11 11 11.00 0 Test (Basin Reserve) 2 3 126 105* 63.00 1 What is Virat Kohli's record in ODIs at Hnry Stadium? One innings, and it is the best he has played in the city in white-ball cricket. On January 31, 2014, chasing 304 in the fifth ODI, Kohli came in with India 20 for 2 and was still there at 39 for 3 in the 16th over. He reached fifty from 60 balls with five fours and a six, added 67 for the fifth wicket with MS Dhoni, and was 81 not out at drinks with India 141 for 4. Nathan McCullum eventually had him holing out at long-on for 82 off 78 balls, with seven fours and three sixes, in the 37th over. India were bowled out for 216 and lost by 87 runs, completing a 4-0 series defeat. Kohli also bowled seven overs for 36 and dismissed Brendon McCullum, caught by Rohit Sharma. MORE: Jacob Duffy gets Virat Kohli's wicket, teases RCB teammate as 'annoying' after Auckland ODI What is Virat Kohli's record in T20Is at Hnry Stadium? His single T20I innings here was brief, though he finished the night as the match-winner. On January 31, 2020, Kohli came in at No. 3 and was caught by Mitchell Santner off Hamish Bennett for 11 from nine balls, surprised by the extra bounce, with India 48 for 2 in the fifth over. Manish Pandey's unbeaten 50 from 36 dragged India to 165 for 8 from 88 for 6, and New Zealand needed seven from the final over with seven wickets standing before Shardul Thakur conceded six runs and took four wickets to tie the match. item.title: Spurs praise Fox for 'A-plus' defense with game on the line in win over Mavs
item.description: San Antonio Spurs guard De'Aaron Fox (4) goes to the basket against Dallas Mavericks' Cooper Flagg (32) and Daniel Gafford (21) during the first half of an NBA basketball game, Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, in San Antonio. (Darren Abate/AP Photo/Darren Abate) Victor Wembanyama had a career night with 52 points and 24 rebounds, but the Spurs needed some strong defense by De'Aaron Fox in the final seconds to pull out a 112-111 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday night. Fox knew he had his work cut out for him when he found himself nose to nose with Kyrie Irving at the top of the key with 10 seconds left and the Spurs leading by a point before a sellout crowd of 18,354 at the Frost Bank Center. "He's one of the toughest covers ever," Fox said of the nine-time All-Star and holder of the venue's single-game scoring record. Fortunately for the Spurs, Fox was more than up to the difficult task against one of the NBA's all-time clutch performers. Irving started his dribble with about 7 seconds left, but Fox shadowed him at every turn and contested the shot strongly at the end, forcing Irving to miss badly on a 15-foot turnaround jumper with 2.5 seconds left. Dylan Harper then beat Naji Marshall for the rebound as the Spurs held on to improve to 6-2 with their sixth win in a row and second of the season against the Mavericks (4-4). Fox, who finished with 10 points and four assists, said he thought back to the days when "you play on-one-on and there's no help" as he faced off with Irving, who finished with a team-high 29 points on an inefficient 9-of-27 shooting from the field. "Just trying to press up, try to make him uncomfortable, which is a hard thing to do," Fox said. "You just try to force a tough shot because you know he's going to be able to create a shot. You just want to make it a shot he wants less than whatever he's thinking at the time. Then contest it." Irving, who scored 57 points for Cleveland against the Spurs at the Frost in March 2015, admitted Fox bothered him just enough. "I felt I got a good look and had my legs underneath me as well," Irving said. "D Fox did a great job of bumping me off my spot." Fox also received praise from his coach and teammates. "There may not be a scarier guy with the basketball in his hands in that moment," Spurs coach Mitch Johnson said. "That feels unguardable and he's going to get a very high-quality shot up. So for De'Aaron to be on an island then guard a few moves off the dribble and then stay down on a shot fake and then contest without fouling, yeah, it's an A-plus effort." Wembanyama agreed. "He was great," the French superstar said. "He did everything he was supposed to do. I'm really glad Dylan got that last rebound. That was a great possession from start to finish." item.title: Atiku flags off ADC campaign in Kebbi, pledges security, fuel subsidy restoration
item.description: By Haruna Aliyu, Birnin Kebbi BIRNIN KEBBI — Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has pledged to address Nigeria’s security challenges and restore fuel subsidy if elected president in the 2027 general elections. Atiku, the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), made the promises during the flag-off of his campaign in Kebbi State, where he described the forthcoming election as a referendum on the policies of the President Bola Tinubu administration. He said the election would provide Nigerians with an opportunity to decide whether to retain the current government or embrace an alternative amid concerns over economic hardship and insecurity. Supporters of the ADC converged on the party’s secretariat in Birnin Kebbi to welcome Atiku and other party chieftains ahead of the campaign rally. Speaking at the event, the Director-General of the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Austin Akobundu, commended party members for attending the gathering despite what he described as intimidation by the state government. Akobundu said the 2027 election would be a referendum on the performance of the Tinubu administration, adding that hunger, insecurity and unemployment would feature prominently in the campaign. The ADC National Chairman, in his remarks, described the party as a moving train that could not be stopped by intimidation. He urged Kebbi residents to vote for Abubakar Malami as governor, Atiku as president and other ADC candidates in the 2027 elections. Atiku and his running mate also criticised some projects being presented as achievements of the Tinubu administration, alleging that they were legacies of the late President Muhammadu Buhari. They described the ADC as an alternative for Nigerians seeking improved security and a reversal of the fuel subsidy policy. The rally climaxed with the ADC National Chairman formally presenting the party’s flag to Malami as its governorship candidate for the 2027 election. Meanwhile, security was heightened in Birnin Kebbi ahead of Atiku’s arrival, with security personnel deployed across parts of the state capital to prevent any breakdown of law and order. The campaign rally ended peacefully, with no reported attacks or destruction of vehicles, unlike the violence alleged to have accompanied the party’s campaign activities in Sokoto State. Two killed, 20 abducted in Kaduna community attack
item.description: By Ibrahim Hassan-Wuyo KADUNA — Two persons have reportedly been killed and 20 others abducted after suspected terrorists invaded Akwando community in Kachia Local Government Area of Kaduna State. The attackers reportedly stormed the community around noon on Wednesday, shooting residents and abducting several people. The police had yet to officially confirm the incident as of Thursday. The President of the Kuturmi Unity Development Association (KUDA), Dr Joseph Ariko, and its Publicity Secretary, Manasseh Samuel Akwando, disclosed the attack in a statement expressing concern over the security situation in Kuturmi communities. The association said the latest attack had worsened the plight of residents still struggling to recover from previous assaults, particularly the Easter Sunday attack on Ariko community. It described the recurring incidents as a threat to the lives, livelihoods and ancestral heritage of the affected communities. KUDA identified the 20 persons reportedly abducted from Akwando as Usman Galadima, La’a’zarus Genesis, Madalin Markus, Happy Stephen, Lovet Ishaya, Afiniki Irimeya, Amina Ahmadu, Miracle Genesis, Hellen Irimeya and Musa Genesis. Others are Janet Irimeya, Gloria Markus, Zila Stephen, Alis Ahmadu, Haske Ahmadu, Great Isiac, Hanatu Irimeya, Desmon Ishaya, Siam Shagari and Nansy Genesis. The association recalled that the Easter Sunday attack on Ariko reportedly claimed five lives at the scene, while another 17 victims subsequently died in captivity. It also cited an earlier attack on Awon community, during which two persons were reportedly killed and 11 others abducted. According to KUDA, five of those abducted in Awon regained their freedom on November 3, 2026, but one reportedly died the following day. Another victim escaped, while five others allegedly died in captivity. The association said the recurring attacks had forced residents to flee their homes, abandon their farmlands and suspend economic activities for fear of further assaults. It further alleged that armed groups had restricted residents’ access to their ancestral lands, compelling some to pay levies before cultivating their farms or harvesting agricultural produce. However, KUDA said the allegations required independent investigation and urged security agencies to establish the circumstances surrounding the incidents and identify those responsible. It called on the Federal and Kaduna State governments, as well as the Kachia Local Government Council, to strengthen security in Akwando, Ariko, Awon and other vulnerable communities. Specifically, the association demanded the deployment of adequately equipped security personnel, establishment of permanent security posts, regular patrols and effective early-warning mechanisms to prevent further attacks. It also appealed for coordinated security operations to secure the release of the 20 residents reportedly abducted in Akwando and others still being held captive. item.title: Ranking NFL defenses by QB hits & sacks entering Week 9
item.description: The Denver Broncos lead the NFL in quarterback hits and sacks through the first eight weeks of the 2026 season, with 74 combined plays resulting in a QB hit or sack. The Minnesota Vikings and Detroit Lions follow, while the New York Giants rank last in the category entering Week 9. NFL defenses ranked by QB hits and sacks: https://t.co/9RnU3246qr — Ari Meirov (@MySportsUpdate) November 5, 2026 The numbers highlight which defenses have consistently made life difficult for opposing quarterbacks, with several teams separating themselves from the rest of the league. MORE: Predicting upsets in Week 9 of NFL season Broncos lead the NFL in quarterback hits and sacks Nov 1, 2026; Denver, Colorado, USA; Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton on the sidelines against the Kansas City Chiefs during the second quarter at Empower Field at Mile High. Mandatory Credit: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Denver sits at the top of the rankings with 74 total plays, including 51 quarterback hits and 23 sacks. The Broncos have established themselves as one of the league’s most disruptive defensive units, creating pressure on opposing quarterbacks throughout the opening eight weeks. The Vikings rank second with 59 combined QB hits and sacks, recording 34 quarterback hits and 25 sacks. Minnesota’s 25 sacks are the second-most in the league, trailing only the Pittsburgh Steelers, who have 26. The Detroit Lions are third with 57 total plays, including 33 quarterback hits and 24 sacks. Seattle (56) and Buffalo (55) round out the top five. item.title: Red Wings would be 'in a lot of trouble' without their goaltending depth
item.description: While John Gibson recovers from an upper-body injury, Michal Postava stands to gain ground with the Detroit Red Wings. Postava was on the ice long after the morning skate ended on Thursday, Nov. 5, honing his skills with the help of goaltending coach Michael Leighton. Postava was slated to back up Daniil Tarasov in the evening's game against the Vegas Golden Knights. Postava was called up Wednesday, the day after Gibson was injured late in the first period of Tuesday's 4-2 loss at the Tampa Bay Lightning . Coach Todd McLellan said Gibson was still being evaluated Thursday and is day-to-day. Having Postava in the system is like having an ace up one's sleeve. "Michal in particular, ever since he's come to North America, has done a real good job of working his way up in the Grand Rapids situation to taking over there and now working his way up to here," McLellan said after the morning skate. "His effort in Edmonton was very good. It was inspiring for the players, and when a young goalie can come up and do that, it's a real positive thing." This is Postava's second stint with the Wings, having been called up under emergency conditions during their trip out west after Tarasov suffered an injury during a practice on Oct. 21. Postava flew from Grand Rapids to Vancouver the morning of Oct. 22 and ended up relieving Gibson for the third period against the Canucks after the veteran was unable to play when he got something in his eye. Two nights later, Postava earned his first career NHL victory in his first start, at the Edmonton Oilers , stopping 24 shots in regulation and overtime before turning away all three shootout attempts he faced. He was sent back to the minors when the Wings returned to Detroit. Now he's back, and even just practicing with the Wings is a boost. RISING UP: J.T. Compher, Michael Rasmussen playing up to Red Wings' standard at last "First time was quick, and I am just happy to be there every day," Postava said. "Being here, it helps me to save these shots. It's hard shots and some clever shots. So it's been good working on it, and it helped me." Postava is a great story: A free agent signee in the summer of 2025, he received a two-year contract. He was earmarked to back up Sebastian Cossa, the franchise's pick at No. 15 in 2021. Cossa did play the majority of the games during the 2025-26 regular season – 39, to 25 by Postava – but when Cossa struggled down the stretch, Postava was handed the net and excelled, and he hasn't stopped. He was just selected as the AHL Goaltender of the Month for October after going 4-0 last month with a 1.25 goals-against average and a .954 save percentage. He joins Detroit with a perfect 5-0-0 record with a 1.20 goals-against average and a 0.955 save percentage in five starts with the Griffins during the 2026-27 season. To have three goaltenders they trust is a big comfort for the Wings. "I can't speak for every team, but the ones that I've been on, you plan for three NHL-caliber people," McLellan said.

item.title: Northamptonshire Steelbacks cricketer serves one-month ban for cocaine
item.description: Northamptonshire Steelbacks batter Chris Lynn was handed, and served, a one month ban following a positive drug test for cocaine after the club won the T20 Vitality Blast final on July 18th. The Cricket Regulator confirmed that Lynn produced an Adverse Analytical Finding (AAF) following a drug test taken on Finals Day and an investigation was launched. Lynn’s urine sample was sent to the WADA-accredited Laboratory in the Laboratoire Anti-Dopage, France for analysis and returned Adverse Analytical Findings (“AAF”) for cocaine’s Metabolite benzoylecgonine meaning that it was a violation of cricket’s anti-doping rule. Cocaine is a substance banned “In Competition” but the investigation found that Lynn had taken the drug on the night of July 15th into the early hours of July 16th outside of competition. Having also provided evidence supporting this position the regulator accepted that Lynn’s use of cocaine amounted to an out-of-competition ADR violation and was unrelated to sporting performance. The regulator charged Lynn with two ADR violations in September and sought a suspension of three months. The second of those violations – ADR Article 2.2 – in that the Cricketer Used a Prohibited Substance, namely cocaine, on or before 18 July 2026 (the “ADRVs”) – was withdrawn as the reported level of cocaine in the sample was below the minimum reporting level required. Lynn acknowledged and accepted the findings of the regulator and informed them of his decision to undergo a substance of abuse treatment programme. In October, the regulator received evidence that Lynn had completed the programme and his suspension was reduced to one month. That ban was served between Lynn’s provisional suspension on 31 July 2026 until 11.59pm on 30 August 2026. Northants beat Hampshire in the Vitality Blast T20 final at Edgbaston this year (PA) The findings also concluded that there was no requirement to inflict any sanction Northamptonshire Steelbacks. A statement from the Cricket Regulator reads: “The Cricket Regulator has imposed a one-month suspension on former Northamptonshire Steelbacks cricketer Chris Lynn. The period of suspension has now been served. “Mr Lynn produced an Adverse Analytical Finding (AAF) for the presence of cocaine's Metabolite, benzoylecgonine, related to an In Competition sample collected on the 18 July 2026. “Mr Lynn has accepted the sanction. No further comment will be made on this matter.”

item.title: The FAA is finally ditching floppy disks
item.description: The air traffic control tower is seen San Diego International Airport on May 27th in San Diego, California. | Photo by Kevin Carter / Getty Images It's the year 2026 and the Federal Aviation Administration is still running critical pieces of American airspace on 3.5-inch magnetic floppy disks. But those technology artifacts could be headed for the dustbin after Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced an effort to ditch floppy disks in favor of a new digital system. Duffy announced Thursday that the FAA is rolling out the Enterprise - Information Display System (E-IDS) to replace four legacy setups across more than 400 air traffic control facilities. E-IDS aggregates real-time weather alerts, equipment outages, restricted airspace changes, and pilot reports onto a modern digit … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: Diana Taurasi headlines 2027 Women’s Basketball Hall of Fame class
item.description: Two elite scorers, a pair of championship-winning WNBA coaches, a longtime referee and a trailblazing administrator will make up the next class inducted into the Women’s Basketball Hall of Fame. The Hall of Fame – based in Knoxville, Tennessee – announced the 2027 class on Thursday, Nov. 5. It includes WNBA all-time leading scorer Diana Taurasi , the legendary Iowa sharpshooter "Machine Gun" Molly Bolin Kazmer, WNBA coaches Sandy Brondello and Mike Thibault, refereeing veteran Dee Kantner and Dr. Judith Holland, the former director of women’s athletics at UCLA. The induction ceremony for these six inductees will be held Saturday, June 26, 2027 in Knoxville. "For nearly thirty years, the Women’s Basketball Hall of Fame has honored the greatest of the game, and we are thrilled to welcome these six inductees into the distinguished seats of the Hall of Fame," Michelle Marciniak, CEO of the WBHOF said in a statement. "Selection for this esteemed recognition celebrates the hard work, success, and record-breaking journeys for those to join this global class. We cannot wait to welcome the Class of 2027." Here’s a closer look at each inductee: Diana Taurasi The WNBA’s all-time scoring leader spent her entire career with the Mercury and won three championships. One of the best women’s basketball players ever, Taurasi was an All-WNBA selection 14 times and led the league in scoring five times. She’s also the WNBA’s all-time leader in 3-pointers and free throws made and probably the league’s greatest trash talker. Prior to her professional career in the WNBA, the native of Glendale, California played at UConn where she became one of the best players to come through Geno Auriemma’s storied program . Taurasi led UConn to three national championships, was twice the Most Outstanding Player at the Final Four, and was the consensus National Player of the Year in 2003. Taurasi owns more Olympic gold medals than any other basketball player in the history of the event with six. She also has three FIBA World Cup gold medals, and while playing overseas in Russia and Turkey she won six EuroLeague championships. Molly Bolin Kazmer Nicknamed "Machine Gun Molly," Bolin Kazmer was arguably the greatest to have ever play the 6-on-6 version of girls and women’s basketball that was popular for decades in states like Texas, Oklahoma and Iowa. As a senior at Moravia High School in Iowa, Bolin averaged 54.8 points per game. She then went on to play collegiately at Grand View University, where she adjusted to the 5-on-5 game. As a 17-year-old, she was selected to participate in the final tryouts of the 1976 U.S. women’s basketball Olympic team. Two years later, Bolin became the first player to sign with the Women’s Professional Basketball League (WBL), joining her home team, the Iowa Cornets. The league was short-lived, lasting just three years, but Bolin was an all-star in each one, leading the league in scoring and was its co-MVP in 1980. She set the league’s single-game scoring

item.title: Ferrari confirms Charles Leclerc's Brazilian GP schedule after birth of first child
item.description: Motorsport photo Ferrari has confirmed that Charles Leclerc will miss Thursday's media day ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix following the birth of his first child. The Monegasque driver and his wife, Alexandra, announced earlier this week that they had welcomed their daughter, Bianca, and Ferrari has now explained what this means for his race weekend in São Paulo. Drivers' Thursday media commitments are normally mandatory, but an absence like this would be treated as an approved exemption rather than a breach of the regulations. "Charles has been exempt of attending media activities today in São Paulo, following the birth of his daughter," the team posted on social media. The Maranello outfit added that Leclerc will arrive at the track in time to take part in the remainder of the race weekend. "He will resume regular track activities from tomorrow morning," Ferrari added. Charles has been exempt of attending media activities today in São Paulo, following the birth of his daughter. He will resume regular track activities from tomorrow morning. ❤️ https://t.co/0dVTsPR2aj — Scuderia Ferrari HP (@ScuderiaFerrari) November 5, 2026 Leclerc is already due to be replaced by Dino Beganovic in the first practice session as part of the mandatory rookie outings, so Leclerc's first on-track session this weekend will be FP2. This will be Beganovic's third FP1 session of the 2026 Formula 1 season. The team had initially planned to run Rafael Camara for the practice session. But plans for his practice debut changed when Haas announced he would replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the season. There are just four rounds remaining in the 2026 season. While Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed his maiden championship title at the Mexican Grand Prix, the fight for second in the standings continues. Leclerc currently sits fifth in the championship, but only 16 points separate the 29-year-old and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in second. The Brazilian Grand Prix will take place at Interlagos on Sunday 8 November at 2pm local time (5pm UK time). To read more Motorsport.com articles visit our website .

item.title: Dylan Larkin banner taken down at Little Caesars Arena
item.description: DETROIT — There's another sign the Red Wings are moving on from Dylan Larkin around Little Caesars Arena. Larkin's banner on the side of the Red Wings' home arena has been removed, likely during the Wings' recent road trip. More: Niyo: Larkin leaves his legacy no way out in Detroit Larkin left the Wings' team Oct. 29 , he and his agent Pat Brisson expressing frustration with the pace of trade discussions. Larkin asked to be traded in June . The Wings have not been able to finalize a trade, saying there have been no equitable returns. Interim general manager Shawn Horcoff announced Larkin was being suspended Oct. 29. Larkin is forfeiting $41,237.11 for each day he sits out. Larkin, who has five years remaining on an eight-year contract worth an average of $8.7 million annually, has scored at least 30 goals in five consecutive seasons. Larkin has submitted a list of 10 teams he'd agree to a trade, but few, if any, have the salary cap room or players the Wings would like in return. Larkin could be adding more teams, soon. tkulfan@detroitnews.com @tkulfan This article originally appeared on The Detroit News: Dylan Larkin banner taken down at Little Caesars Arena

item.title: Matt Olson named as 2026 Silver Slugger finalist at first base
item.description: ATLANTA, GEORGIA - AUGUST 11: Matt Olson #28 of the Atlanta Braves hits a two-run homer in the eighth inning against the New York Mets at Truist Park on August 11, 2026 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images) | Getty Images It’s already been a busy award season for Matt Olson, as the star first baseman for the Atlanta Braves has already racked up a Fielding Bible Award and a Gold Glove Award as well. He now has a shot at adding some more hardware to his personal trophy cabinet, as he’s been named as a finalist for a National League Silver Slugger Award at first base. Congratulations to Matt on being named a Silver Slugger Finalist! pic.twitter.com/3eybAurGNc — Atlanta Braves (@Braves) November 5, 2026 For Olson, he’ll be looking to pick up his second Silver Slugger award after he took home the trophy following the 2023 season. Olson finished this year batting .251/.321/.502 with a .351 wOBA (and an identical xwOBA), 122 wRC+ and 41 home runs. Olson led the NL in homers, his slugging percentage placed him in second among eligible first basemen in the National League and he was also in second when it came to Isolated Power (.251). Considering the competition (Jake Bauers, Alec Burleson, Rafael Devers), I’d imagine that Olson will be a longshot for this award. Still, it’s always impressive to see a player in this era get nominated for both the Silver Slugger Award and the Gold Glove Award in the same season. Matt Olson has provided consistent production for Atlanta since his arrival in 2022 and it’ll be interesting to see just how long he can continue to perform at such a high level. The award winners will be announced on November 17, so stay tuned for that.

item.title: Bellingham: “This is the mindset we need to maintain”
item.description: Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham talked to the press after the team’s encouraging 2-3 comeback against AEK Athens in the Chanpions League where he was named the Man of the Match. “It was a very tough game. We worked hard to win this and came back twice. A very important victory on our journey in this season’s Champions League. Another comeback, but this is the Real Madrid mentality and the mindset we need to maintain for the rest of the season. We’re heading to Valencia with great enthusiasm, and hopefully, we can win because the most important match is the next one,” he said. Bellingham briefly talked about his brilliant goal. “It was instinct and a bit of quality. It was a great ball from Marc (Cucurella),” he explained. He also praised his teammate Fede Valverde after he scored the game-winning goal with an impressive shot from distance. “Much better than mine. It’s no surprise that Fede shoots like that, but it was a very important goal for us, as you could see in the team’s reaction. We’re very happy with the three points,” he concluded.

item.title: Submit your Week 9 Las Vegas Raiders mailbag questions!
item.description: (Photo by Ethan Miller/Getty Images) | Getty Images In terms of number of games, halftime of the Week 9 contest against the San Francisco 49ers will mark the halfway point of the Las Vegas Raiders’ 2026 season . Seeing as Klint Kubiak’s crew has already surpassed last year’s win total, it’s safe to say the Raiders have taken a step forward this year. But how big of a step remains to be seen, and getting a win against a playoff-caliber club like the 49ers would be a great way to build some momentum heading into the second half. Also, we have the NFL trade deadline coming up on Tuesday , giving us a lot of topics to dive into for this week’s mailbag. As always, anything Raiders-related is on the table and fire away with anything that’s on your mind. Send your questions my way by either dropping a comment in the comments section below, tweeting at me ( @MHolder95 ) or via email at SBPQuestions1@gmail.com . I’ll follow up with another column in the coming days. If you don’t have a commenting account already, you’ll need to create one but the steps are pretty easy and it’s a seamless process. Also, we have full-time moderators to enforce the Community Guidelines.

item.title: Football fans angry at sponsor's link to porn actress
item.description: BC Game was announced as a sponsor of Leicester City before the 2024-2025 season [Stephen White - CameraSport via Getty Images] A football fan group has expressed "dismay" that Leicester City's main shirt sponsor has appointed a porn actress as an ambassador. BC Game - which was named as a sponsor for the League One side at the start of the 2024-25 season - named Eva Elfie as a brand ambassador on Tuesday. The online gambling company posted a video of Elfie and a delivery driver on social media, with the caption: "Welcome to BC Game Eva Elfie! Let the fun begin." The Foxes Trust said gambling and pornography could have "devastating impacts", and added: "Partnerships like these bring these two worlds to a larger audience and, by association, link them to Leicester City." In a statement entitled "BC Game - It gets worse", the trust said: "Most Leicester City supporters will know by now the trust's dismay and discontent with BC Game being our front of shirt sponsor. "BC Game have now announced a new partnership with 'international content creator and esports personality' Eva Elfie... who just happens to be an international porn star. "From the moment the club decided to take sponsorship from a betting company we felt Leicester City were ditching its values. "Now throw into the mix that BC Game have entered into a partnership with someone who continues to make their name via adult content. "Both gambling and pornography can have devastating impacts on people's lives, in particular young people. "Partnerships like these bring these two worlds to a larger audience and, by association, link them to Leicester City. Is this who we are now?" In a post on LinkedIn on Tuesday, BC Game said Elfie had an "established presence in gaming communities". Chief executive Ali "Ako" Muhanned said: "Eva has built an incredible relationship with the gaming and esports community through genuine passion and consistent content creation." Announcing the club's partnership in 2024, Leicester City said BC Game - which is not available to users in the UK - was a "socially responsible platform" and aimed to provide an "enjoyable and safe gaming experience". Susan Whelan, the former club chief executive, previously said: "We welcome BC Game to Leicester City - an opportunity to work with an innovative partner in a new category for the club. "As a leading global operator in a rapidly evolving environment, BC Game already have a history of successful relationships in sport, and we look forward to the development of a mutually beneficial partnership." The BBC has approached both BC Game and Leicester City for comment. Listen to BBC Radio Leicester on Sounds and follow BBC Leicester on Facebook , on X , or on Instagram . Send your story ideas to eastmidsnews@bbc.co.uk or via WhatsApp on 0808 100 2210. Related internet links Leicester City

item.title: Power generation drops to 3,659MW as FG explains supply disruptions
item.description: By Obas Esiedesa, Abuja Electricity generation on Nigeria’s national grid dropped to 3,659 megawatts (MW) as of 3pm on Thursday, from a peak of 3,996MW recorded on Wednesday, amid worsening power supply across parts of the country. The Federal Government attributed the decline to gas supply constraints to thermal power plants, reduced water inflows into hydroelectric reservoirs and operational challenges within the power sector. Data obtained from the Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO) showed that the decline had affected electricity allocation to Distribution Companies (DisCos), resulting in shorter hours of supply and increased load shedding across distribution networks. Data on the distribution load allocation dashboard as of 5:39pm on Thursday showed that the 11 electricity distribution companies received a combined allocation of 3,031MW. Abuja Disco received the highest allocation of 669MW, followed by Ibadan Disco with 413MW and Port Harcourt Disco with 338MW. Benin Disco received 279MW, Enugu 267MW, Eko 256MW, Ikeja 249MW, Kano 173MW, Kaduna 167MW, Jos 146MW, while Yola Disco received the lowest allocation of 74MW. The Federal Ministry of Power, in a statement on Thursday by the Special Adviser (Media and Publicity) to the Minister of Power, Adeola Adelabu, acknowledged complaints by electricity consumers in Lagos, Abuja, Ogun, Kwara and Oyo states over worsening supply in recent days. The Ministry noted that the affected areas had recently experienced noticeable improvements in electricity supply before the latest disruptions. It, however, ruled out a major or systemic failure of the national grid, explaining that preliminary assessments linked the disruptions to maintenance and operational challenges in parts of the power value chain, alongside declining generation. Acknowledging the impact of the disruptions on consumers, the Ministry said: “We recognise what every hour without power means for individuals, families and businesses, and we do not take it lightly.” It added that the Minister of Power, Joseph Tegbe, was working with the Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN), NISO and electricity distribution companies to address the challenges and restore normal supply. According to the Ministry, the Minister had engaged relevant operators to resolve the operational constraints, accelerate ongoing maintenance and keep the public informed about restoration efforts. In a separate statement, NISO confirmed that limited gas availability had constrained the ability of affected thermal generating stations to operate at their available capacities, while reduced water inflows had affected hydroelectric generation. The system operator stated: “The limited availability of gas has constrained the capacity of affected thermal generating stations to operate at their available levels, while reduced water inflows into reservoirs have impacted the generation capacity of hydroelectric power stations.” NISO explained that the reduction in available

item.title: Where can I watch the Dolphins vs. Lions game?
item.description: MIAMI GARDENS, FLORIDA - NOVEMBER 01: Caleb Douglas #7 of the Miami Dolphins looks on against the New England Patriots during the first half of the game at Hard Rock Stadium on November 01, 2026 in Miami Gardens, Florida. (Photo by Megan Briggs/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Miami Dolphins host the Detroit Lions in Week 9, kicking off on Sunday afternoon from Hard Rock Stadium. Miami lost in Week 8, dropping to 1-6 in a season that is focused on establishing a foundation for a rebuilding team. The Lions are coming off a win to give their NFC North rivals, the Minnesota Vikings, their first loss of the year. Detroit is 5-2 this season, but third in their division. After a disappointing 9-8 season last year, the Lions are looking to fight their way back to the top of the NFC North in route to another deep playoff run. This is a game between a team that is likely headed toward an early pick in the 2027 NFL Draft and a team hoping to be a factor in the NFC postseason. The television broadcast plan seems to mirror exactly who each team is. Reminder: Affiliates can elect to change their coverage assignments during the week – we will update on Sunday if there are any changes to the Dolphins’ viewing area. Where will the Lions vs. Dolphins game air on TV? The good news about the broadcast plan for this week is CBS has assigned Kevin Harlan and Trent Green to the coverage. Harlan’s play-by-play call is becoming legendary in Miami, and we will once again get to experience it on Sunday. The bad news is, not much of Florida will receive the game on their local CBS channel. With Miami struggling, only the Miami, West Palm Beach, and Fort Myers markets will get the game. As for the markets interested in the game because of the Lions side of the schedule, all of the NFC North will get to watch. All of Michigan and Wisconsin will air the game, along with most of Minnesota. The Chicago market in northern Illinois and Indiana will pick up the game, as will the Toledo, Ohio CBS affiliate. . What other games will I see in Florida? 1 p.m. Eastern time slot On CBS, most of the state will see the New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs game, while Tampa will air the Denver Broncos at Carolina Panthers game and the western end of the Panhandle will have the Cleveland Browns at New Orleans Saints game. FOX has the doubleheader this week and will start with the Dallas Cowboys at Indianapolis Colts game throughout most of Florida. The New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles game is expected to be shown in Miami and West Palm Beach. 4:05/4:25 p.m. Eastern time slot The second game on FOX will be the Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots game throughout all of Florida. 8:20 p.m. Eastern time slot – Sunday Night Football The Sunday Night Football game this weekend will feature the Tampa Bay Buccaneers at the Chicago Bears.

item.title: LIV Golf officially winding down after 5 years
item.description: Reinhold Matay-Imagn Images LIV Golf officially winding down after 5 years appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The end is coming for LIV Golf . The Saudi Public Investment Fund pulled funding for the tour, and then LIV later filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection. BC Partners considered investing in a relaunch of LIV 2.0 , but has pulled funding. Now, after five years, LIV Golf is officially winding down , according to NUCLR GOLF. “Officially confirmed in U.S. Bankruptcy Court this morning, lawyers for the league say 2.0 will not move forward, marking the end of an era for a tumultuous time in professional golf. LIV Golf’s lawyer: ‘We believe the wind down path is the best path,'” NUCLR GOLF posted on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The reason that BC Partners decided to withdraw their $300 million offer to support LIV 2.0 after the league could not get enough player commitments for 2027. The remaining assets for LIV will be sold off , and the creditors for LIV will be meeting on November 20. Another bankruptcy hearing is set for November 24. There have already been multiple high-profile golfers who have left the tour ahead of this announcement. Brooks Koepka and Patrick Reed had already cut ties with the tour after their contracts ended. Meanwhile, golfers including John Rahm, Sergio Garcia, and David Puig had all already decided not to be part of the LIV 2.0 reboot, leaving the tour without marketable names for the rebirth of the league. The league launched in 2022, with an eight-tournament schedule. The tour grew to 14 events in 2023, and maintained that in 2023 and 2025. The tour managed just 12 events in 2025, with two scheduled events being cancelled. Related: BC Partnership pulls $300 million investment deal, LIV Golf heading toward liquidation

However, its promotional material has attracted unwanted attention from James and his representatives, who have made it clear that the basketball superstar has no connection to the company. item.title: You don't have to go to the moon to see Earth differently: Artemis II astronaut Victor Glover on what really matters
item.description: null TENERIFE, Canary Islands — Imagine traveling over 250 million miles from home, watching Earth disappear behind the moon and losing contact with the billions of people who call it home. What would you miss most? For Artemis II astronaut Victor Glover, the answer wasn't a particular place, a familiar view or even the comforts of home. It was something much more fundamental: human connection. Speaking during a discussion with former astronaut Chris Hadfield at the Starmus VIII festival on Oct. 18 in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Glover reflected on the extraordinary experience of traveling around the moon and how being so far from Earth had given him a renewed appreciation for the people living on it. "The greatest reason to go to space, it isn't to be a swashbuckler hero," Glover said. "It's to do something that only 651 people have been able to do: miss Earth and miss other Earthlings." Glover was one of the four astronauts aboard NASA's Artemis II mission, which launched on April 1, 2026 , marking humanity's first crewed journey to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972. Alongside NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman and Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen, the crew traveled farther from Earth than any humans before them. As the Orion spacecraft traversed the far side of the moon, the Artemis II crew watched Earth disappear below the lunar horizon before losing radio contact with our planet. Around 40 minutes later, Earth came back into view as the spacecraft emerged from behind the moon. NASA’s Orion spacecraft captures the Moon and the Earth in one frame during the Artemis II crew’s deep space journey at 6:39 p.m. ET on the sixth day of the mission. (Image credit: NASA) For Glover, however, the experience was about much more than the view. He believes that if everyone on Earth had the opportunity to make the same journey, they would come away with a similar appreciation for what they'd left behind. "I think all of us would say something in our native language, in the most basic way we can communicate about love, joy, hope and inspiration," Glover said. Although Glover shared the extraordinary journey with three fellow astronauts, the four of them were separated from the rest of humanity by hundreds of thousands of miles. And for Glover, that distance brought with it a strange contradiction: the farther he traveled from humanity, the more he longed to connect with it. "At the point of ultimate disconnection, [there is] this longing for connection," Glover said. The experience gave him a perspective that he carried back into everyday life. "There are moments where I am rushing through traffic and want to get where I'm going because I'm being selfish," Glover admitted. "But I don't have to stay there." Instead, he remembers what it felt like to look back at a planet so distant that everyone who has ever lived could be covered by his hand. "I wish you could all feel what it's like to come back home after that disconnection," he said

item.title: SDP condemns attempts to disqualify ADC presidential candidate, Atiku
item.description: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Social Democratic Party (SDP) has condemned alleged attempts to disqualify the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, insisting that political parties should be allowed to freely present candidates for the 2027 general elections. The party also called on the judiciary, security agencies and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to remain impartial and protect the country’s democratic process. The SDP National Chairman, Prof. Sadiq Gombe, stated this on Thursday in Abuja while addressing journalists after a meeting with the party’s nine governorship candidates from different states. Gombe, who said the SDP would not participate in the proposed ‘Rainbow Coalition’, reaffirmed the party’s commitment to contesting the 2027 elections under its own political platform. He also accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of allegedly plotting to infiltrate opposition parties and weaken their ranks ahead of the elections. The SDP chairman alleged that the APC, having lost the confidence of Nigerians over its governance record, was using the proposed coalition to woo opposition members and undermine their unity. He, however, said the SDP was working with other opposition parties towards building a coalition of Nigerians committed to credible elections, including joint training of party agents and the establishment of common situation rooms to protect votes at polling units. Gombe reaffirmed the party’s commitment to presenting what he described as credible alternatives to Nigerians, particularly its presidential candidate, Prince Adewole Adebayo, and vice-presidential candidate, Prof. Usman Bugaje. He said: “I want to assure you that SDP, as a political party, has nothing to do with anything called Rainbow Coalition. “We are with other political parties in the opposition, doing everything possible to rescue our dear country through a coalition of the Nigerian people. “We are not into any Rainbow Coalition where we will have candidates here and profess support for the APC presidency. We are SDP and we are for SDP candidates.” He said the party had resolved to discipline any member who participated in the proposed arrangement without its authorisation. According to Gombe, the meeting with the governorship candidates was part of preparations to strengthen the party’s electoral strategies and improve its chances in the 2027 general elections. He said the engagement provided an opportunity for candidates from different states to share experiences, identify organisational gaps and develop strategies for winning elections at national and state levels. The SDP chairman urged Nigerians to assess the party’s candidates based on their competence, capacity, character and patriotism. He also pledged the party’s commitment to credible elections, saying it would collaborate with other opposition parties on election monitoring, polling agent training and the establishment of joint situatio

item.title: 2027: Presidency seeks global safeguards against AI-generated falsehoods
item.description: –As Onanuga warns of threat to democratic institutions, public trust By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ABUJA–THE Presidency has called for urgent global action to check the growing misuse of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in political communication, warning that unchecked deployment of the technology could undermine democratic institutions, distort electoral processes and erode public trust ahead of Nigeria’s 2027 general elections. Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Information and Strategy, Mr Bayo Onanuga, made the call on Thursday in Beijing, China, while delivering a paper titled, “AI and the Future of Global Communication”, at the 7th World Media Summit organised by Xinhua News Agency and the People’s Government of Beijing Municipality. Onanuga said the proliferation of AI-generated videos, images and other digital content for political purposes had made it imperative for governments, media organisations and technology stakeholders to establish safeguards against disinformation and manipulation. According to him, social media platforms, including X, Facebook and TikTok, were increasingly inundated with AI-generated content designed to advance political interests, entertain audiences and influence public opinion. With political activities and campaigns ahead of the 2027 general elections gathering momentum, the presidential aide said AI had become a powerful instrument in the hands of politicians and their supporters, with the potential to serve both legitimate and destructive purposes. “We are in the thick of the political season and campaigns ahead of the 2027 general elections, where new political leaders at the national and sub-national levels will be elected. AI, for good and bad, has become a powerful tool for electoral contests for politicians and their supporters. “Some political actors use AI to spread falsehoods, some use it satirically for entertainment, and some highlight candidates’ achievements,” he said. He stressed that the growing influence of AI in political communication demanded greater responsibility from political actors, media organisations and the general public, particularly in verifying information before creating, publishing or sharing digital content. While acknowledging the dangers associated with the technology, Onanuga cautioned against disregarding its enormous contributions to human development, particularly in medicine, mathematics and other areas of scientific innovation. He noted that AI had become deeply embedded in everyday life, citing its applications in vehicle safety systems, navigation and other technological solutions that had improved human efficiency and convenience. “Today, AI governs our existence, and we encounter it all the time. In the car, it warns you about your immediate surroundings. It maps your fastest route to your destination. We can go on, citing AI’s Leviathan impact on our lives. “I believe we can no longer ignore AI’s penetrating impact, most of it beneficial, unless we want to retur

item.title: iDICE Named Official Deal Room Partner for Afreximbank’s CANEX WKND 2026
item.description: The Investment in Digital and Creative Enterprises (iDICE) Programme, a US$617 million initiative of the Federal Government of Nigeria implemented by the Bank of Industry (BOI), will take part in Afreximbank’s Creative Africa Nexus Weekend (CANEX WKND 2026) as one of the event’s official Deal Room Partner. The US$617 million programme is implemented by the Bank of Industry (BOI), which also co-finances it alongside the African Development Bank (AfDB), Agence Française de Développement (AFD) and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB). It backs young Nigerians aged 15–35 and the businesses they build in the technology and creative sectors through skills development, enterprise support, access to finance and enabling infrastructure. CANEX WKND 2026 holds from 5 to 8 November 2026 in Lagos under the theme “One People, United in Culture, Creating for the World,” bringing together creatives, investors, financial institutions, policymakers and development partners from across Africa and the diaspora. At the heart of iDICE’s participation is the iDICE Deal Room, which will host structured meetings between 15–20 investment-ready creative and digital enterprises and investors and financiers, including iDICE-backed fund managers Ventures Platform and Kuramo Capital, the BOI-iDICE Debt Fund, the BOI Non-Interest Banking team managing the IsDB-supported facility, and participating financial institutions. The Deal Room aims to hold 40–50 investor–enterprise meetings and generate investment leads for follow-up after the event. iDICE and BOI will also take part in high-level sessions on financing and technology in the creative economy, and showcase programme-supported enterprises at the iDICE exhibition stand. “Nigeria’s digital and creative industries hold significant potential to drive economic growth, create jobs, expand exports and strengthen the country’s global competitiveness. Realising this potential requires sustained investment in enterprise development, access to finance and the capabilities of our young people. Through the iDICE Programme, the Federal Government and the Bank of Industry are working with development partners to address these needs and build a stronger ecosystem for digital and creative enterprises. CANEX WKND provides an important platform to deepen engagement with industry stakeholders, connect creative entrepreneurs to investment opportunities and advance the partnerships needed to grow the sector,”said Ife Adebayo . The National Coordinator of the iDICE Programme, Ife Adebayo, added: “The Deal Room is about turning conversations into investment. We are bringing some of the most promising enterprises from the iDICE pipeline to meet financiers ready to back them, while showing what iDICE is already delivering for young Nigerian founders and creatives.” Creative and tech entrepreneurs attending CANEX WKND 2026 are invited to visit the iDICE Exhibition stand to learn about available financing and support, including non-interest financing

item.title: ADC: Sokoto turnout prompted judgment voiding Atiku’s candidacy
item.description: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has alleged that the turnout at its political event in Sokoto influenced the timing of a court judgment that nullified the leadership of its David Mark-led faction and voided the party’s presidential candidacy. The party’s spokesperson, Bolaji Abdullahi, made the allegation on Channels Television’s Lunchtime Politics , while reacting to the judgment. Abdullahi said the party would challenge the ruling, insisting that the legal battle was part of what he described as sustained efforts to frustrate its political activities. He claimed that the ruling party was determined to remain in power and prevent Nigerians from having a democratic choice in the 2027 elections. “We’ve spent more time in the courts than we’ve spent on the campaign grounds, thanks to the ruling party,” he said. The ADC spokesperson alleged that the judgment was expedited following the party’s political outing in Sokoto. “But I think in the matter of hours after seeing what happened in Sokoto yesterday, the kind of reaction, the kind of turnout in Sokoto yesterday, they had to quickly go and dust up this and hurry up the judgment this morning,” Abdullahi said. He, however, said the ADC remained confident in its ability to challenge the ruling through the judicial process. “We will approach the same court. We believe in the judicial institution, regardless of the recklessness of some judges who have allowed themselves to be used as a tool for subverting democracy in Nigeria,” he said. Abdullahi said the party would apply for a stay of execution and appeal the judgment. He warned that if the ruling stood, the ADC could be prevented from fielding candidates for the presidential, governorship, National Assembly and other elections. “What is endangered is not the African Democratic Congress. What is endangered is Nigeria as a country and our democracy as we’ve known it,” he said. The ADC spokesperson maintained that the party’s message of change, affordability and improved living conditions had gained nationwide support, urging that Nigerians be allowed to choose their preferred leaders. He insisted that the judgment would not stand, adding that the party would continue its legal challenge. item.title: SDP rejects ‘Rainbow Coalition’, vows to contest 2027
item.description: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Social Democratic Party (SDP) has declared that it will participate in the 2027 general elections, distancing itself from the proposed ‘Rainbow Coalition’ and insisting that it has no intention of entering any political arrangement that could compromise its identity. The party also accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of allegedly plotting to infiltrate opposition parties and weaken their ranks ahead of the elections. The National Chairman of the SDP, Prof. Sadiq Gombe, stated these on Thursday in Abuja while addressing journalists after a marathon meeting with the party’s nine governorship candidates from different states. Gombe said the SDP had no interest in joining any arrangement that would compromise its political identity or align its candidates with the ruling party. He alleged that the APC, having lost public confidence over its governance record, was using the proposed coalition to woo opposition members and undermine the unity of other political parties. The chairman, however, said the SDP was working with other opposition parties towards building a coalition of Nigerians committed to credible elections, including joint training of party agents and the establishment of common situation rooms to protect votes at polling units. He reaffirmed the party’s commitment to presenting what he described as credible alternatives to Nigerians, particularly its presidential candidate, Prince Adewole Adebayo, and running mate, Prof. Usman Bugaje. Gombe said: “I want to assure you that SDP, as a political party, has nothing to do with anything called Rainbow Coalition. “We are with other political parties in the opposition, doing everything possible to rescue our dear country through a coalition of the Nigerian people. “We are not into any Rainbow Coalition where we will have candidates here and profess support for the APC presidency. We are SDP and we are for SDP candidates.” He said the party had also resolved to discipline any member who participated in the proposed arrangement without its authorisation. According to him, the meeting with the governorship candidates was part of preparations to strengthen the party’s electoral strategies and improve its chances in the 2027 general elections. He said the engagement provided an opportunity for candidates from different states to share experiences, identify organisational gaps and develop strategies for winning elections at national and state levels. Gombe urged Nigerians to assess the party’s candidates based on their competence, capacity, character and patriotism. He also pledged the SDP’s commitment to credible elections, saying it would collaborate with other opposition parties on election monitoring, training of polling agents and the establishment of joint situation rooms. “We will be our own INEC at the polling units and our own security to ensure free, fair and credible elections come 2027,” he said. item.title: Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily Keel Infrastructure sold its entire bitcoin treasury in the third quarter, offloading 2,520 bitcoin for $192 million and leaving the company with only nominal holdings at Sept. 30, the former Bitfarms miner reported Thursday. The sales covered the 2,261 bitcoin Keel held going into the quarter plus the 259 it mined, and the company said it timed them during periods of strength. Going forward, bitcoin mined from Keel’s remaining Quebec operations will be sold on a daily basis, “effectively eliminating the Company’s exposure to Bitcoin price movements on treasury holdings.” The move completes a shift Keel began earlier this year, when the company, then still trading as Bitfarms (BITF), started selling its stack and winding down U.S. mining to fund high-performance computing and AI infrastructure. From bitcoin miner to AI landlord Keel Infrastructure Corp. rebranded from Bitfarms after completing a U.S. redomiciliation to Delaware in April and now describes itself as a North American digital infrastructure and energy company. Legacy bitcoin mining still shows up in the results, but the center of gravity has moved. Revenue from continuing operations fell to $28 million from $68 million a year earlier, largely because Keel stopped U.S. bitcoin mining in the second quarter and because the average bitcoin price declined. Adjusted EBITDA swung to a negative $27 million from a positive $19 million. General and administrative expenses roughly doubled to $34 million as the company hired senior specialists and booked higher stock-based compensation. The company still posted about $780 million of unrestricted cash as of Nov. 4 and said it has no current need for debt or equity financing before signing a lease. “Power supply is getting scarcer while demand keeps climbing,” CEO Ben Gagnon said in the release. “Keel’s 2027 and 2028 power is further advanced, more secure, and closer to delivery than it was last quarter.” CFO Jonathan Mir added that capital deployed ahead of a lease becomes equity in project financing and that the company examines opportunities to recycle capital on an ongoing basis. What Keel is building instead Construction began at Moses Lake in September after Keel cleared Notice to Proceed, and the company expects it to be the first energized site generating HPC revenue in 2027. It also engineered an optional plan for next-generation Vera Rubin architecture at the site. Permitting advanced at Sharon and Panther Creek in Pennsylvania, and load studies could expand secured data center capacity from 478 MW toward nearly 1.9 GW if Panther Creek and Scrubgrass expansions proceed. Keel has also moved to consolidate older bitcoin sites into a single AI campus. The development pipeline stands at about 2.2 gigawatts with grid interconnections already in place across Pennsylvania, Washington State and Québec. That is the inventory Keel is trying to lease be

item.title: Evidence of active volcanoes on Mars may boost chances of finding life
item.description: Evidence of volcanic activity was detected near Alba Mons on Mars Mars Express & HRSC Mars may be volcanically active, say scientists who have linked evidence of gases often produced by magma with photographs of fresh fissures found on the surface of the Red Planet. The findings could be interpreted as good news in the hunt for life, as a continuous heat source would be needed to keep microorganisms safe from frigid temperatures on the surface. Scientists have seen evidence of volcanoes on Mars in the past few million years and seismic activity has hinted that some may still be active, but no evidence of lava flows or current eruptions had previously been found. Read more Why we must investigate Phobos, the solar system’s strangest object In 2019, the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter detected evidence of hydrogen chloride (HCl) in Mars’s atmosphere. That gas is commonly associated with magmatic vents on Earth, and researchers wondered if the same was true on Mars. Advertisement To investigate further, Daniel Mège at the Polish Academy of Sciences and his colleagues looked at the little data available – just 15 recorded instances of the gas – alongside newly taken photographs of the surface. They were able to link recent, narrow fissures in the Alba Mons region of Mars to the HCl emissions, providing strong evidence of underground lava flow. To assess whether the HCl could have come from the fissures, the team modelled the wind direction at the time the measurements were taken. Free newsletter Sign up to Launchpad Sign up to newsletter “We have 2 kilometres of wind between them, and in this season there are a lot of dust devils. So, the atmosphere is turbulent. It’s an enormous mess,” says Mège. Nicolas Thomas at the University of Bern, Switzerland, another team member, stresses that until the area is investigated up-close, there will always be doubt about the source of the gas. But, he argues, this finding makes the case for further surface exploration of Mars. “Suspicion is one thing, proof is better, right?” says Thomas. “I’m a terrible sceptic. Until you put something down there and you actually sniff the stuff coming out of the ground, you haven’t got unambiguous proof.” Thomas thinks the finding makes the prospects for life on Mars more likely. “We know that Mars, even at the equator, can be −70°C, −80°C at night. It’s a very harsh environment,” he says. “If this thermal source were constant and continuous, then you have to admit it’s improving the situation [in terms of the hunt for life].” “This is definitely a highly interesting finding,” says Lena Noack at the Free University of Berlin. “Many scientists working on Mars will not be too surprised, as the picture of a ‘dead’ Mars was inconsistent with many recent research findings.” Journal Reference: Science Advances DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aeb942
